howItWorksPage.heroSubtitle: From discovering elite live concerts to walking through the VIP entrance — your seamless ticketing journey in 4 effortless steps.
howItWorksPage.stepsSectionSubtitle: We crafted a friction-free booking platform designed for speed, clarity, and peace of mind.

step1.title: Discover & Choose Your Event
step1.desc: Browse curated premier concerts, live shows, and cultural galas. View rich details including venue maps, artist lineups, dates, and live remaining capacities.

step2.title: Select Seats on the Interactive Map
step2.desc: Pick your preferred table or seating section in real-time. Your selection is atomically locked for 15 minutes to guarantee no double-bookings while you checkout.

step3.title: Instant & Secure Checkout
step3.desc: Pay effortlessly with bank-grade encryption powered by Stripe. No hidden surprises — transparent pricing with instant automatic payment confirmation.

step4.title: Get Your QR Ticket & Enjoy the Show
step4.desc: Receive your official digital ticket instantly via email with an embedded QR code, or download it in high definition. Scan at the gate for fast, contactless entry.

howItWorksPage.featuresSubtitle: Engineered for excellence, reliability, and unforgettable entertainment memories.
howItWorksPage.feat1Desc: Atomic database-level table locking ensures your chosen seat is exclusively reserved the instant you click.
howItWorksPage.feat2Desc: Official admission passes delivered directly to your inbox with high-resolution QR codes powered by Resend.
howItWorksPage.feat3Desc: 100% PCI-DSS compliant checkout via Stripe ensures your card details never touch intermediate servers.
howItWorksPage.feat4Desc: Our support concierge is always ready to assist you at support@khaleejitour.com for any inquiries.
howItWorksPage.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about booking and attending our events.

faqs.q1: How do I receive my tickets after booking?
faqs.a1: Immediately after payment is verified by Stripe, your digital ticket appears on screen with a high-resolution QR code. A confirmation email with the ticket pass is also dispatched instantly to your email address.
faqs.q2: How long are my selected seats held during checkout?
faqs.a2: When you select tables or seats, our system locks them exclusively for you for 15 minutes. This gives you plenty of time to enter your details and complete payment safely without losing your seats.
faqs.q3: Can I download or print my ticket?
faqs.a3: Yes! On the booking success page or in 'My Tickets', you can download a crisp HD image of your ticket card with one click or use the clean Print/PDF option.
faqs.q4: What do I need to present at the venue entrance?
faqs.a4: Simply show your ticket's QR code on your mobile phone screen (from your email, the website, or saved image) to our security gate staff for a quick 1-second scan.
faqs.a5: We support all major credit and debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express) through Stripe's secure checkout infrastructure.
